protocol.sample: Official NBA results, 2025-01-01 through 2025-01-08; convenience sample, not a full season
protocol.reward_type: Non-monetary research points; no funded prize or payment
protocol.tuning_policy: No hyperparameter tuning on validation or test outcomes. All choices above are fixed for this retrospective pilot. Retrospective registration cannot erase prior researcher knowledge.
notes: No historical sportsbook quotes are available from an inspected official source.
No home-court adjustment: display order is not treated as verified home/away across the sample.
No injury, lineup, rest, travel or referee features are invented.
Player thresholds are cohort-level experimental lines, not personalized player forecasts.
No strategy can earn rewards without every release gate passing.

gates.name: Official provenance
gates.requirement: Every input value has an official NBA source and passes integrity checks.

gates.name: No future information
gates.requirement: All evaluation features precede the date being predicted; parameters frozen after training. Training-only residual fitting may use the full training window.

gates.name: Sample size
gates.requirement: At least 300 settled selections and 30 distinct dates.

gates.name: Official executable prices
gates.requirement: Timestamped official sportsbook quotes, limits and applicable rules for every selection.

gates.name: Settlement audit
gates.requirement: Operator-specific pushes, voids, participation and overtime rules matched to every ticket.

gates.name: Probability quality
gates.requirement: Locked holdout beats a matched baseline; dependence-aware interval excludes no improvement.

gates.name: Multiple testing
gates.requirement: Complete trial registry and family-wise error control on a sufficiently large independent holdout.

gates.name: Joint dependence
gates.requirement: Stable out-of-sample joint calibration and actual ticket prices; pairwise correlation alone is insufficient.

gates.name: Prospective replication
gates.requirement: At least 100 frozen pre-event paper tickets across 2 seasons.

gates.name: Risk and execution
gates.requirement: Positive lower-bound net return after price/limits/voids; predeclared drawdown and exposure limits pass.

strategies.name: Strength → moneyline
strategies.signal: Shrunk scoring-for/against differential, frozen logistic calibration; require an official price edge ≥3 percentage points.
strategies.test_plan: Frozen logistic probability versus de-vigged official two-way price; no price, no selection.

strategies.name: Strength → spread
strategies.signal: Own half-point spread from expected margin; trade only against a verified better official line.
strategies.test_plan: Margin MAE and price-adjusted cover return versus constant-margin and market baselines.

limitations: Only 62 games over eight dates; no full-season representativeness.
Only two complete player box scores; no personalized player prop forecasts.
No verified historical sportsbook odds, limits or ticket settlement records.
No home/away, injury, lineup, rest, travel or referee adjustment.
Date-cluster intervals suppressed below 20 dates; luck cannot be eliminated.
Cohort-level prop thresholds are experimental, not official or personalized lines.
Model-derived values are calculations from cited inputs, not official NBA betting lines.
